title: Action Conditioned Bisimulation For GUI Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2609.38778v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An agent that remembers what it did on a web page must decide when two pages count as the same. Memories built on observation similarity merge pages that look alike but behave differently, and GUIs are full of such pages: two tabs of one widget or two rows of one menu answer the same click differently. We define the merge rule as an action-conditioned bisimulation over the empirical predictive state graph a frozen agent fills as it acts. Two states merge only when their shared actions lead to agreeing outcomes and successor blocks under an affordance label. Observation similarity never enters the rule, and nothing is trained. It replaces the merge rule of an existing outcome-value memory, so a closed-loop comparison isolates it. translated_title: 面向GUI智能体记忆的动作条件互模拟
translated_abstract: 一个记住自己在网页上做过什么的智能体，必须判断两个页面何时应算作相同。基于观测相似度构建的记忆会将外观相似但行为不同的页面合并，而GUI中充满了这样的页面：同一组件的两个标签页或同一菜单的两行，对相同的点击会给出不同的响应。我们将合并规则定义为动作条件互模拟（action-conditioned bisimulation），作用在一个冻结智能体在行动过程中逐步填充的经验预测状态图上。只有当两个状态在同一可供性标签下，其共享动作导致一致的结果和后继块时，它们才会被合并。观测相似度完全不参与该规则，也不进行任何训练。该规则替换了现有结果价值记忆的合并机制，因此通过闭环比较可以将其贡献单独隔离出来。在MiniWoB++上，它比无记忆智能体提升了成功率，而采取相同探索绕路的对照组、先前的后继表示合并方法、以及不带动作条件的相同准则……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出以动作条件互模拟作为GUI智能体记忆的页面合并规则——仅当两个状态的相同动作产生一致结果时才合并，完全不依赖观测相似度且无需训练，在MiniWoB++上提升了智能体成功率。
en_tdlr: Proposes an action-conditioned bisimulation as the merge rule for GUI agent memory—states merge only when their shared actions lead to agreeing outcomes—requiring no observation similarity and no training, and improving success rate on MiniWoB++.
